pages.text: $(italic)A whirlwind of steel and fury. Raw melee power that scales harder the closer you are to death.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -5%  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Core Identity:$() +15% base melee damage on all weapons.

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Brutal Strikes$() — +15% melee damage with all weapons. Always active, unconditional.$(br2)$(bold)Blood Fury$() — Below 40% HP: +20% melee damage. The core risk/reward passive.$(br2)$(bold)Thick Skinned$() — +10% armor effectiveness. Rewards heavy armor.$(br2)$(bold)Battle Trance$() — +5% attack damage and +1 natural armor. Your constant fury hardens you.

pages.title: Playstyle
pages.text: The $(thing)Berserker$() wants to be in melee range, taking hits. Blood Fury + Brutal Strikes at low HP = devastating burst. Combined with Thick Skinned, you survive longer than your HP suggests.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Orc$() — +10% melee stacks for +25% base.$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$() — +40% HP makes Blood Fury safer.$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$() — Fire resistance + armor stacking.
